args.command:
foreach ($j in 'C:\vmm-own\jl', 'C:\vmm-own\jtarget') { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $j) { cmd /c rmdir $j } }
foreach ($d in 'C:\vmm-own', 'C:\vmm-victim', 'C:\vmm-rootpush', 'C:\vmm-rootref') { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath "\\?\$d" -Recurse -Force } }
[void](New-Item -ItemType Directory 'C:\vmm-own')
[void](New-Item -ItemType Directory 'C:\vmm-victim')
Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim\keep.txt' -Value keep
# A folder that ordinary users may change, as a user's own folder is: Users get full control, which lets them rename entries.
icacls C:\vmm-own /inheritance:r /grant:r '*S-1-5-32-545:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-18:(OI)(CI)F' '*S-1-5-32-544:(OI)(CI)F' | Out-Null
cmd /c mklink /J C:\vmm-own\jl C:\vmm-victim | Out-Null
cmd /c mklink /J C:\vmm-own\jtarget C:\vmm-victim | Out-Null
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp\vmm-victim.sddl') -Value (Get-Acl -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim').Sddl
'ready'

$app = 'C:\vmm-own\new\deeper\app'
cmd /c mklink /J "$app\jl" C:\vmm-victim | Out-Null
cmd /c mklink /D "$app\sl" C:\vmm-victim | Out-Null
[void](New-Item -ItemType HardLink -Path "$app\hl.txt" -Target 'C:\vmm-victim\keep.txt')
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$app\ro.txt" -Value ro
Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath "$app\ro.txt" -Name IsReadOnly -Value $true
(Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath $app | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object Name) -join ','

$t = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp'
'app=' + ((Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-own\new\deeper\app' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object Name) -join ',')
'keep=' + (Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim\keep.txt')
'victim=' + ((Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim' | ForEach-Object Name) -join ',')
if ((Get-Acl -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim').Sddl -eq (Get-Content -LiteralPath "$t\vmm-victim.sddl")) { 'victim-acl=same' } else { 'victim-acl=changed' }
'vmm=' + (Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-own\new\deeper', $t -Filter '.vmm-*' | Measure-Object).Count

contains: C:\vmm-own\jl is a junction, a symbolic link or a mount point
push to a path without one

args.command:
$t = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp'
'victim=' + ((Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim' | ForEach-Object Name) -join ',')
if ((Get-Acl -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-victim').Sddl -eq (Get-Content -LiteralPath "$t\vmm-victim.sddl")) { 'victim-acl=same' } else { 'victim-acl=changed' }
'vmm=' + (Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath 'C:\vmm-own', $t -Filter '.vmm-*' | Measure-Object).Count

function Rules($d) { foreach ($r in '', '\a.txt', '\été.txt') { $a = Get-Acl -LiteralPath "$d$r"; "$r protected=$($a.AreAccessRulesProtected)"; $a.Access | ForEach-Object { "$r $($_.IdentityReference) $($_.FileSystemRights) $($_.InheritanceFlags) $($_.PropagationFlags) inherited=$($_.IsInherited)" } } }
$ref = 'C:\vmm-rootref'
[void](New-Item -ItemType Directory $ref)
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$ref\a.txt" -Value a
Set-Content -LiteralPath "$ref\été.txt" -Value e
$pushed = Rules 'C:\vmm-rootpush'
$made = Rules $ref
if (Compare-Object $pushed $made) { 'acl=differs'; $pushed; '--'; $made } else { 'acl=same' }

# Who other than SYSTEM, Administrators and CREATOR OWNER may delete or rename entries in %SystemRoot%\Temp, where pushes stage.
$trusted = 'S-1-5-18', 'S-1-5-32-544', 'S-1-3-0'
$risky = [Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]'Delete, DeleteSubdirectoriesAndFiles, ChangePermissions, TakeOwnership'
$found = @((Get-Acl -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp')).Access | Where-Object { $_.AccessControlType -eq 'Allow' -and ($trusted -notcontains $_.IdentityReference.Translate([Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value) -and ($_.FileSystemRights -band $risky) } | ForEach-Object { "$($_.IdentityReference) $($_.FileSystemRights)" })
if ($found.Count) { 'temp-delete-rights=' + ($found -join '; ') } else { 'temp-delete-rights=none' }
